title: Write funny answers
text: Each prompt goes to two players. You'll get two prompts on your phone. Funny beats correct!

scene.phone: The worst thing to hear from your pilot
scene.title: Prompt 1 of 2

title: Head to head
text: Answers go up on the TV in pairs. Everyone who didn't write that prompt votes for the better one.

title: Vote on your phone
text: Tap the answer you like best. Your vote is secret until the reveal.

title: Score big
text: Points follow the share of votes. Win every vote for a clean sweep bonus. Round two is worth double!
